about: Questions whose everyday name is the catalog's own phrase (CTO and OPUS, Nov 28, 4:27 a.m.: 'That's how people really talk about these laws... realism wins.'). Shrink-only: a new entry needs a CTO line naming the question; an entry is removed as soon as its said stops holding the catalog's phrase. policy-name-in-speech.test.ts reads it.

questions.us-policy-positions:fiscal.adopt-income-: People call it 'an income tax'; there is no other word for it.
questions.us-policy-positions:labor-workforce.loca: Everyone says 'the minimum wage'; the question is who sets it.
questions.us-policy-positions:environment-energy.b: People call it 'the bottle deposit' at the register.
